problemStatement:
Architecting an SVG icon library that balances bundle size, dynamic styling with `currentColor`, caching, and DOM performance.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Poor icon architectures are the #1 cause of massive JS bundle bloat in frontend applications.
interviewTrap: Shipping an icon library where importing one icon bundles all 1,500 SVGs into the user's bundle.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Inline SVGs allow dynamic CSS `fill: currentColor` and hover states but bloat the JS bundle. SVG sprite sheets cache across pages via HTTP but require network fetching. Icon compilers generate tree-shakeable individual component wrappers.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals:
## 🎨 SVG Icon System Architectures

### Architectural Comparison
| Approach | Bundle Size Impact | Dynamic Styling (`currentColor`) | HTTP Caching | Tree-Shaking |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Inline React Components** | High (if not split) | ⭐⭐⭐ Native | ❌ In JS | ⭐⭐⭐ (if subpathed) |
| **SVG Sprite Sheet** | ⭐⭐⭐ Zero JS | ⭐⭐ Via `<use>` | ⭐⭐⭐ HTTP Cached | ⭐⭐⭐ Network fetch |
| **Icon Font** | ⭐⭐ Small | ⭐ Restricted | ⭐⭐⭐ HTTP Cached | ❌ All or nothing |

### Modern Senior Recommendation: Tree-Shakeable SVGR Compilers
Use SVGR to compile SVGs into individual ES module React components:
```tsx
// @ds/icons/Check.js
export const CheckIcon = ({ size = 16, className, ...props }) => (
  <svg
    width={size}
    height={size}
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth="2"
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={className}
    {...props}
  >
    <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12" />
  </svg>
);
```
